name: History Untold
overview: Join Hobbyist Researcher, Todd Sweeney (definitely not comedian Kate Dolan in a wig) as he documents the forgotten tales of those who haven’t had their story written in the history books. With guests like Elizabeth III Worcestershire, Peter Pans’ Lesbian mums, the first dude who got the plague and the virgin Mary’s pregnancy test, you’ll learn so much about the world and hey… you might even learn something about yourself.
